purpose: Preregistered adversarial challenger to Granola; not a claim of improved leaderboard performance.
account_constraint: Create under the existing GLEE account. Do not create a second account.

bargaining.name: DiscountLatch
bargaining.scope: Only discounted players facing an exactly repeated, positive opponent offer.
bargaining.change: Accept the repeated offer; otherwise delegate to Granola.
bargaining.hypothesis: Avoid a demonstrated class of discount losses without weakening Granola's successful proposal policy.

negotiation.name: NashFloorBracket
negotiation.scope: Complete-information, strictly positive-surplus, explicitly unknown and uncapped horizons only.
negotiation.change: Open at 55% of surplus, accept at 45%, and bracket rejected demands against incoming offers; otherwise delegate to Granola.
negotiation.hypothesis: Increase surplus capture in the only cell where waiting has no documented hard deadline.

persuasion.name: TemplateBayesExactGuard
persuasion.scope: Text templates and exact public-prior buyer indifference; binary and all other economic logic delegate to Granola.
persuasion.change: Treat high-grade as positive, serviceable/nothing-fancy as weak, require two negative exposures before an exact-tie positive purchase, and stop after a purchased positive low.
persuasion.hypothesis: Close the observed template-coverage gap and reduce the largest buyer downside tail while preserving seller pooling probabilities.

primary_metrics: normalized own payoff within role and configuration strata
persuasion buyer downside and seller conversion by signal class

gates.bargaining: Agreement rate at least 90%, with mean normalized payoff no more than 5 percentage points below matched Granola strata.
gates.negotiation: No identifiable missed positive-surplus trade and no-deal rate at most 15% in eligible positive-surplus games.
gates.persuasion: Exact-indifference buyer outcomes nonnegative in aggregate and text classification coverage at least 95%.

interpretation_limits: Archive replay measures action divergence, not counterfactual payoff.
Matchmaking is not randomized, so unmatched rating changes are not causal estimates.
A challenger module is retained only after family-level gates and trace review, not because it wins a single game.
